note: NOT a converter target. The app (SmartCompareApp/) is React Native + Expo and does not render in a browser. The design project holds hand-authored WEB JSX references (ui_kits/mobile/*.jsx, exporting window.Qaren<Screen>, previewed by ui_kits/mobile/*.html) that mirror the RN screens. A re-sync means: diff the RN source-of-truth against the matching .jsx reference and integrate by hand — do NOT run package-build.mjs / the storybook or package converter against SmartCompareApp. See .design-sync/NOTES.md.

Per-category structure: app/services/scoring_service.py CATEGORY_DIMENSIONS + DIMENSION_DISPLAY_NAMES; extraction_service.py CATEGORY_SPEC_SCHEMAS + build_category_profile; price_service.py CATEGORY_FAIRNESS.
